title: Animation with Animation playback track at time 0 will keep previewing the sub-animation on Stop
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.5.stable.official [876b29033]

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900K (24 threads) - 63.75 GiB memory

### Issue description

I have a "master" Animation Player node which controls other "sub" Animation Player nodes by using the Animation Playback Track. All the tracks are played from time 0 (first frame).

When I'm done previewing the whole animation with Animation panel Play button, I click Pause then Stop to stop the previewing on the timeline, but the sub animations keep playing.

Here is a MWE for a simpler case with a single one-shot sub-animation:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ccbc8814-fb1b-437f-9f68-8b0d5ed90c8a

(in my case, I have many sub animations and they all loop so it's really distracting)

Also, a side effect is that if I press Ctrl+S at that moment, it saves a bunch of nodes at non-default positions, resulting in VCS showing a lot of unwanted diff.

### Steps to reproduce

(Steps 1-3 may be skipped if loading the MWE below)
1. Create a MasterAnimationPlayer, an AnimationPlayer and a Sprite2D
2. On the AnimationPlayer, add a dummy animation moving the Sprite2D
3. On the MasterAnimationPlayer, add an Animation Playback Track that plays the dummy animation created in step 2

(jump here if using MWE)
4. Open MasterAnimationPlayer in the Animation tab, preview the animation, then Stop

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test-animation-playback-track-never-stops-preview.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24132196/test-animation-playback-track-never-stops-preview.zip)
